title: A Colony for the Signal
author: Sable Halloran
blurb: Ada Pemberton, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
